results.question: Name of Work
results.answer: Construction of 200 quarters (i.e. 150 - Grade B/C, 50 - Grade A) and Podium with Amenity & multipurpose hall, including Internal Water Supply, Sanitary Installation, Drainage, Modular Furniture, Internal Electrical Installations, Lifts, Firefighting and Fire-alarm System, D.G. sets, STP, OWC, Substation & Pump house, Rain water Harvesting System, Internal roads with street lighting, Signages, Compound wall, etc. for Reserve Bank of India, Ekta Nagar, Mazagaon, Mumbai
results.source: 1NITPARTA.pdf, Page 6, Notice Inviting e-Tender

results.question: Scope of work
results.answer:
• Execution on EPC Mode-III turnkey basis as per GFC/approved drawings including foundation, structure, finishing, and modular furniture.
• Construction of Tower 1 (G+5 podium parking + 1 amenity podium + 2 service floors + 26 residential floors for 100 Grade B/C units) and Tower 2 (G+4 podium parking + 1 amenity podium + 2 service floors + 26 residential floors for 50 Grade A & 50 Grade B/C units).
• Construction of a separate Multipurpose Hall building, Utility & Service Areas (DG, Substation, OWC, Entrance Gate, Security Cabin), and Compound Wall.
• Structural execution using Monolithic Concrete Construction with Aluminium Formwork Technology above 1st floor slab level, and conventional RCC framed structure up to 1st floor slab level.
• Execution of complete MEPF services: Internal/external water supply, sanitary, drainage, STP, OWC, UGT, rainwater harvesting, HT/LT substation, DG sets, UPS, HVAC, lifts, firefighting & fire alarm systems, CCTV, FTTH, BMS, EV chargers, rooftop solar PV & solar water heating systems, internal roads, street lighting, landscape lighting, and signages.
• Compliance with IGBC Platinum rating requirements.
results.source: 1NITPARTA.pdf, Page 32-37, Section-I Brief Particulars of Work & 2NITPARTB.pdf, Page 172-179, Scope of Civil Works

results.answer: The contractor whose bid is accepted will be required to furnish performance guarantee of 5 % (Five Percent) of the Estimated cost put to tender (ECPT) or bid amount whichever is higher, within the period specified in Schedule F.

results.answer:
• Option 1: Performance Guarantee shall remain valid for a minimum period of six months beyond the date of completion of all contractual obligations as per GCC.
• Option 2: Security deposit, performance guarantees and any other deposits or recoveries etc. shall be released only on completion of full work under the contract agreement as per terms of General conditions of contract for EPC works.

results.question: Defect liability period
results.answer:
• Option 1: 24 Months after the date of actual completion and handing over of work to client, as recorded by Engineer-in-charge. However, Contractor shall own the responsibility of satisfactory performance of the completed work for a period of 5 (five) years including the Defect Liability Period of 2 years.
• Option 2: The contractor shall have obligation to rectify all defects in the structural elements or any other part of building/structure/road etc. due to deficiency at his own cost for 10 (Ten) years from the date of completion and handing over of work to client, as recorded in the completion certificate by the Engineer-in-Charge.
results.source: 1NITPARTA.pdf, Page 8 & Page 33-34, Information and Instructions for Bidders Item 11 & Section-I Clause 14

results.question: Water Supply
results.answer:
• The contractor shall be responsible for arranging and maintaining at his own cost water required for executing the work, testing, commissioning, and facilities for workers.
• All applicable water charges for execution of work, testing, and commissioning shall be arranged by the contractor at prevailing charges payable to local authorities.
• Only potable water shall be used in the work.

results.answer:

results.question: Material & Samples
results.answer:
• Option 1: Samples of all materials being used in the work, methodology and sample of work of all items shall be got approved from the Engineer-in-charge well in advance before procuring and starting execution at site.
• Option 2: Contractor shall ensure that all the samples of the materials, approved make or otherwise shall be got approved from the Engineer-in-Charge in advance before use in the work.
• Option 3: Before commencement of any work at site, the Contractor shall submit material submittals (datasheets, design calculations, sample test certificates, compliance statements) for review and approval by Engineer-in-charge. No work shall be commenced without written approval.
• Option 4: The Contractor shall prepare and execute mock-ups for all typical MEPF materials of at least 01 make from the list of preferred makes, equipment, fixtures, fittings, and finishes proposed to be used in the project within or outside the sample flat to be constructed on the 1st residential floor without extra cost.
results.source: 1NITPARTA.pdf, Page 16, Clause 17; Page 34, Clause 17 & 3NITPARTC.pdf, Page 6-7, Clauses 3 & 4

results.question: Plants & Machinery
results.answer:
• The cost of labour, material, tools and plants and machinery required for execution of the whole project as per attached layout plans and drawings is within the scope of this work.
• The bidder shall be responsible for arranging and maintaining at his own cost all materials, tools & plants, water, electricity access, facilities for workers and all other services required for executing the work unless otherwise specifically provided for in the contract documents.
• Programme of procurement of machinery / equipment having adequate capacity, commensurate with the quantum of work to be done within the stipulated period by the Agency.

results.question: Staff
results.answer:
• Graduate Engineers: The Contractor shall be fully responsible for the execution and supervision of all works and shall engage Graduate Engineers to undertake work in accordance with statutory requirements and conditions of this contract.
• Supervisory Staff: The contractor shall employ Supervisory staff as per NIT provision who will be constantly in touch with the department and sign the site order book.
• Safety Engineer & Supervisor: A competent, qualified, and authorized Safety Engineer shall be on the site whenever the contractor's men are at work. The supervisor shall ensure all plant, machinery, and safety appliances meet applicable standards.
